h: Asake leaves Paris's Accor Arena hand in hand with his mother after final tour show, and the clip trends
p: A clip of Asake walking out of the Accor Arena in Paris hand in hand with his mother after his last show on the tour is trending, with fans praising the moment.
more: The Paris concert was part of his In God We Trust world tour.
Fans have flooded social media with messages for his mother.
